title: Photo & Media Gallery
intro: Real school life, photographed on our campus in Kisakasaka. One uniform, many backgrounds across our NECTA and Cambridge Primary wings.

photos.title: Reading group in Grade 4
photos.caption: Cream polos with the sky-blue collar and the school crest on the chest — our everyday uniform.

photos.title: Morning assembly on the veranda
photos.caption: Every learner is in the same colours, whatever their background.

photos.title: Guided writing in Primary
photos.caption: Small classes and a teacher who knows each child's next step.

photos.title: The junior reading corner
photos.caption: 640 new titles and a carpet where Nursery and Lower Primary start the day.

photos.title: Practical science in the laboratory
photos.caption: Lab coats over the uniform — hands-on experiments every week.

photos.title: Coding & robotics lab, Thursday afternoons
photos.caption: Block-based coding and STEM kits in our ICT room.

photos.title: Culture Day performances
photos.caption: Traditional dress and music on stage.

video.title: Three minutes inside LIS
video.text: A walk-through of our Kisakasaka campus: morning assembly, NECTA and Cambridge classrooms, science and computer labs, the reading corner, and afternoon sports.
